quote: We choose to use the BCubed metrics, obtaining Precision and Recall for the evaluated clustering compared to the reference, as well as an F 1 score.
We manually annotate word clusters (obtained from our best-performing approach, the Agglo Bi-level system) containing at least 2 lemmas according to the semantic similarity between lemmas.
guideline: We distinguish four categories: synonyms when lemmas are cognitive synonyms, nearsynonyms for lemmas close to be synonyms but showing slight difference in meaning, related when lemmas show a topical or lexical relations, and invalid clusters when lemmas show no semantic relation.
